mapper.select: SELECT ticker FROM tbl_companies WHERE ticker = #{ticker} UNION SELECT CASE WHEN EXCHANGE = 'KOSPI' THEN CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KS') WHEN EXCHANGE = 'KOSDAQ' THEN CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KQ') ELSE STOCK_CD END FROM tbl_stock_info WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND (STOCK_CD = #{ticker} OR CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KS') = #{ticker} OR CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KQ') = #{ticker}) LIMIT 1

SELECT ticker AS stockCd , company_name AS stockNm FROM tbl_companies WHERE UPPER(company_name) = #{name} OR UPPER(company_name_ko) = #{name} UNION SELECT CASE WHEN EXCHANGE = 'KOSPI' THEN CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KS') WHEN EXCHANGE = 'KOSDAQ' THEN CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KQ') ELSE STOCK_CD END AS stockCd , STOCK_NM AS stockNm FROM tbl_stock_info WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND UPPER(STOCK_NM) = #{name}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ticker AS stockCd , company_name AS stockNm FROM tbl_companies WHERE UPPER(company_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR UPPER(company_name_ko) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR UPPER(ticker) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') UNION SELECT CASE WHEN EXCHANGE = 'KOSPI' THEN CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KS') WHEN EXCHANGE = 'KOSDAQ' THEN CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KQ') ELSE STOCK_CD END AS stockCd , STOCK_NM AS stockNm FROM tbl_stock_info WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND UPPER(STOCK_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) t ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(t.stockNm) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT company_name FROM tbl_companies WHERE ticker = #{ticker} UNION SELECT STOCK_NM FROM tbl_stock_info WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND CASE WHEN EXCHANGE = 'KOSPI' THEN CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KS') WHEN EXCHANGE = 'KOSDAQ' THEN CONCAT(STOCK_CD, '.KQ') ELSE STOCK_CD END = #{ticker} LIMIT 1
SELECT company_name_ko FROM tbl_companies WHERE ticker = #{ticker} AND company_name_ko IS NOT NULL AND company_name_ko != '' LIMIT 1
